util

Class SystemInfo

  • java.lang.Object
    • util.SystemInfo

  • public final class SystemInfo
extends java.lang.Object
    A comprehensive utility for retrieving detailed system information, including operating system distribution, versioning, network identity, and hardware architecture.

    This utility significantly extends the standard System.getProperty capabilities. While standard Java 8 often identifies Windows 11 as "Windows 10", this class resolves the underlying build numbers to provide accurate marketing names. It also performs deep-scanning of Linux filesystem release files to identify specific distributions such as Ubuntu, RHEL, and Amazon Linux.

    Key Features:

    *
    • Precise Windows Mapping: Distinguishes between Workstation and Server variants, such as Windows 10 vs. Server 2016.
    • Linux Flavour Detection: Scans /etc/os-release and other distribution-specific files.
    • Network Diagnostics: Provides short-name hostname resolution and IP address discovery.
    • Resource Efficiency: Utilises lazy-style static initialisation to reduce memory footprint on non-Linux systems.
    Since:
    1 April 2026
    Version:
    0.4
    Author:
    Trevor Maggs

      • readInfoAIX

        private static void readInfoAIX()
                         throws java.io.IOException
        Queries the AIX operating system to dynamically obtain the current OS name and its version. Note: it executes oslevel to find AIX version. If it cannot compute the OS version, it returns "0.0".
        Throws:
        java.io.IOException - if unable to obtain the information

      • readInfoSolaris

        private static void readInfoSolaris()
                             throws java.io.IOException
        Queries the Solaris operating system to dynamically obtain the current OS name and its version. Note: it executes uname -r to find Solaris version. If it cannot compute the OS version, it returns "0.0".
        Throws:
        java.io.IOException - if unable to obtain the information

      • resolveWindowsBuild

        private static int resolveWindowsBuild()
        Resolves the Windows Build Number by executing the native ver command.

        This is required to distinguish between Windows 10 and Windows 11, as both report a major version of 10.0 in standard system properties.

        Returns:
        the build number (e.g. 22621 for Win 11), or -1 if it cannot be resolved

      • readLocalHostName

        private static void readLocalHostName()
        Resolves the short hostname via Java API with a shell fallback.

        Prefers the Java Networking API. If a Fully Qualified Domain Name (FQDN) is returned, this method truncates it to provide the short hostname only, for example: @code server01} instead of server01.network.com.

        If that hostname cannot be obtained from the Java Networking API, it will fallback by executing hostname command directly in the OS environment. If that host name, however, cannot be obtained, a string "localhost" will be provided.

      • readLocalIPaddress
